verdict.rationale: Trello is a kanban-style project and task management tool, not a code host or code-review tool. AI-driven breakdown and explanation of code diffs falls outside its product category. The evidence shows only generic AI writing assistance and an MCP connector, neither of which is diff analysis, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can have AI break a code diff into focused sections with explanations of what changed and why
